'''High Judicator Frensworth''' is an elite [[human]] located in the mage tower in [[Hearthglen]] in the [[Western Plaguelands]]. After the two broken halves of the Binding of Xanthar were stolen from the small church outside of [[Karazhan]], he claimed the lower binding for his own.

==Objective of==
*Drops [[The Lower Binding of Xanthar]] for {{questlong|Neutral|60+|The Binding of Xanthar (quest)|The Binding of Xanthar}}.
